name: fleetdeck

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@fleetdeck/backend && npm run build --workspace=@fleetdeck/remote-gateway && npm run build --workspace=@fleetdeck/frontend

author: FleetDeck contributors
description: A secure, self-hosted server fleet management console for SSH, RDP, VNC, batch jobs and reusable playbooks.
